fact: In a World Bank mission of 8-12 September 2025 a system integrator (Ooru) began work to design and implement, with INIC and DGRN, a new foundational identity (bilhete de identidade) as a digital ID on MOSIP, with mass enrolment planned for January or February 2026.
title: Projecto Sao Tome e Principe Digital (P177158) - Missao de Apoio a Implementacao - Ajuda Memoria
